diagnosis: Fetch makes no progress with max_addr stuck at 0x00000000 leading to TRAP: no progress and FAIL 0xdead instead of advancing fetches. In state 0 mem_valid is driven to 0 when mem_la_use_prefetched_high_word==0 so no memory transfer is ever started, versus expected 1. Root cause is picorv32.v:584 missing negation `mem_valid <= mem_la_use_prefetched_high_word` which directly contradicts the invariant at picorv32.v:598 `mem_valid == !mem_la_use_prefetched_high_word`.
reason: Diagram shows mem_valid low in state 0 while mem_la_use_prefetched_high_word is low, confirming the missing negation stalls all fetches and matches max_addr 0x00000000.
